text: Ko onon yo yimɓe! Hulee Joomi mon, ɗoftoɗon yamirooje Makko, woɗɗitoɗon haɗaaɗi Makko. Hulon kadi lepte ñalaande, nde baaba duncanoytaa ɓiɗɗo mun, wanaa ɓiɗɗo on kadi duncanoyta ben mun hay huunde. Pellet, fodoore Alla nden yoɓitugol Ñalnde Darngal, ko nde tabitunde, feere mun alaa. Wata on jaɓu nguurdam aduna e welii-fotii majjam hoda on, wata seytaane hodir on ko Alla muññori on kon leelnugol leptude on.
